items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And from then on we became good friends.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Goon -- Billy Eckstine would go cram me down my throat if he knew I couldn't remember Goon's name because we were good friends. But

King Kolax anyway, Kane Collacks was working there in his group. They have five pieces. So we were in there to hear him. We sat at the bar drinking, so all of a sudden here walks in this little cat, and he looked like hell. And Billy recognized him, and he said, hey, Charlie. And Charlie came up to the bar. Billy bought him a drink, and then we learned that he had just hoboed into Chicago off of the freight train. And so Billy said, wait a minute. So he walked up to Goon. He says, look, when you come off, he…

So Goon don't know who Charlie Parker is, and I don't know who Charlie Parker is, you know, so when they come off at intermission, Goon is very happy to let him get up and blow because, you know, we were always looking for some relief so we could get down and that cat with the chicks and whatnot.
